messages:
incident-bot: SEV-1 ALERT - gpu-pool eu-central-1 queue > 90% and autoscaler failing to allocate (429 / QuotaExceeded). Paging oncall.
rachel (sre): ack. I'm responding. Omar, Tina, Kai — can you triage with me? Nina, any customer tickets showing immediate impact?
omar (eng-runtime): noticing rapid queue climb on `gpu-inference-main-euc`. Autoscaler reports: \n```
2026-03-16T14:11:02Z WARN  autoscaler: scale_up attempt 1 -> provider 429
2026-03-16T14:11:08Z WARN  autoscaler: scale_up attempt 2 -> provider QuotaExceeded
2026-03-16T14:12:30Z ERROR autoscaler: max retries reached
```
tina (eng-platform): autoscaler retried 8 times in 6m. No jitter configured; exponential backoff linearized. Also seeing controller stuck in scale-lock for 90s.
kai (infra): FYI provider maintenance note in eu-central: temporary quota reassignments in the cluster. Opening provider case now (CASE-5712). Might be transient but can't rely on it.
nina (support): we have 12 tickets reporting 503s and increased latency; two enterprise customers flagged as P1. They're seeing failed generation and timeouts.
rachel (sre): immediate playbook: 1) divert low-priority traffic to cpu-fallback; 2) open short-lived preemptible spot pool (if provider supports) to absorb burst; 3) drain long-running inference sessions. Omar, can you flip routing and add a temporary TTL for sessions?
omar (eng-runtime): applying route change: \n```
PATCH /routes
{ "policy":"divert-low-latency-tolerant", "match":{"priority":["low","background"]}, "target":"cpu-fallback","ttl":"20m" }
```
deploy-bot: routing patch deployed by omar (deploy id r-932). No errors.
tina (eng-platform): triggered job eviction: removing sessions older than 45s and non-interactive embeddings. Script: \n```
./platform/evict --pool gpu-inference-main-euc --min-age 45s --dry-run=false
```
Result: evicted 140 jobs, 110 rerouted to cpu-fallback.
kai (infra): provider console shows soft quota for instance type a100 at 0 available. Requested temporary quota bump; provider acknowledged and queued our request.
rachel (sre): another mitigation: enable quantized model variants for low-priority inference to reduce GPU memory per model. Omar, can your runtime flip model mapping for priority=low?
omar (eng-runtime): yes. Pushing mapping change: low-priority model -> quantized-8bit variant. Deploying now.
ops-bot: apply mapping change requested by omar. Command: /apply mapping q8-lowpri
ops-bot: mapping applied.
nina (support): CS interim note: telling affected customers we routed background jobs to CPU and enabled degraded quantized models for non-critical traffic. Two customers requested escalation to sales — I'm patching them to account reps.
rachel (sre): good. Kai — can we provision warm Dedicated nodes from our reserved pools as fallback (takes ~7m to warm)?
kai (infra): I can allocate reserved nodes from our Dedicated contract. Requesting manual pool creation now (req DED-2102). ETA 7m.
omar (eng-runtime): autoscaler config tweak: added jittered exponential backoff, capped retries to 3. Restarting autoscaler controller now.
ops-bot: restart initiated: pod/auto-scale-euc-0 restarted by omar.
omar (eng-runtime): logs post-restart show reduced retry churn. Still getting intermittent 429s but not saturating provider API.
ops-bot: reaction :rocket: to omar (eng-runtime)
rachel (sre): monitoring queue and latency. If queue doesn't drop within 12m, we'll promote to manual priority evictions and escalate provider case.
tina (eng-platform): Dedicated nodes registered and joining pool now. Scheduler redistributed queued jobs across new nodes.
ops-bot: reaction :white_check_mark: to tina (eng-platform)
nina (support): customer impact numbers (prelim): region eu-central between 14:11-14:35 UTC saw 21% error rate for requests to embeddings endpoints, 13 unique customers affected, 2 enterprise with >15% failure windows.
kai (infra): provider updated support case: temporary rebalancing due to maintenance. They've provisionally increased soft quota; asked us to submit expected peak load for next 48h.
rachel (sre): action items coming out of live: list them here and owners. We'll make formal incident doc after this.
- ACTION-001: add jitter to autoscaler backoff + cap retry attempts (owner: omar, due: 72h)
- ACTION-002: automated routing fallback for low-priority traffic during provider errors (owner: tina, due: 5d)
- ACTION-003: implement preemptible warm pool flow for spike absorption (owner: kai, due: 1w)
- ACTION-004: create customer notification template for capacity events (owner: nina, due: 48h)
- ACTION-005: run chaos test for provider-429 scenarios in staging (owner: eng-sre, due: 2w)
nina (support): I'll draft the CS summary and send to account teams. Also will post an incident update to affected customers within 2h.
omar (eng-runtime): adding metric: `autoscaler.429_rate` and alerting threshold set to >3 hits/min to warn earlier.
rachel (sre): declaring live mitigation stable. We'll keep the channel open for 1h for monitoring. Postmortem meeting scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Incident doc created.
incident-bot: Incident record created INC-2102239999 - "eu-central-1 GPU scale failure and provider quota rebalancing" - https://incidents.internal/INC-2102239999
rachel (sre): thanks everyone. Good triage and quick mitigation steps. We'll capture timelines and root-cause in the postmortem. Channel will be archived after monitoring window.
ops-bot: reaction :clap: to rachel (sre)
